cohort: The study included primiparous women who had experienced obstetric anal sphincter injuries.
finding: In women with obstetric anal sphincter injuries, forceps-assisted delivery significantly increases the risk of major levator ani avulsion and is independently associated with persistent anal incontinence symptoms at 13 weeks postpartum.
mod_finding: Forceps-assisted vaginal delivery was associated with an almost 6 times higher rate of major levator ani avulsion compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery in women with obstetric anal sphincter injuries.
